# UniCoach

> UniCoach is an Indian study abroad platform. It offers study abroad counselling (university shortlisting, applications, scholarships, education loans and student visas) and 1:1 sessions with verified senior students and alumni who have studied abroad. It also publishes free country guides, exam guides and AI tools for Indian students planning to study abroad.

Key facts:
- Website: https://www.unicoach.com
- Audience: Indian students planning bachelor's, master's or PhD study abroad
- Destinations covered: USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, France, Italy and New Zealand
- Services: study abroad counselling, university shortlisting, SOP and LOR help, scholarship guidance, education loan guidance, student visa assistance, test preparation guidance
- UniCoach mentors: verified seniors and alumni from universities abroad who host 1:1 video calls, SOP reviews and visa guidance sessions
- Office: 1st Floor, Gali No. 4, Sahil Colony, Jattal Road, Sondhapur Village, Panipat, Haryana 132105, India
- Contact: info@unicoach.in, +91 95186 57944 (Mon to Sat, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST)
